D3.why: Thin capital ('$0.9B above the legal minimum against $887B of assets', about 31:1 leverage) is ranked the most urgent fact with its consequence quantified, and the register also covers the -14-month duration gap, EPS-linked pay, the 15% growth maths and the borrowed government backing.

D7.why: Inferences are marked [ASSUMPTION], computed figures (31.6x leverage, GAAP down 22%, 2.4% left to the target) derive correctly from the dossier, the missing hedge, accounting-policy, credit-mix and segment data are flagged, and every gate verdict is conditional on that data.
